about.description: Single-stock perpetual market on Ondo Perps tracking Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc., cash-settled, 24/7, up to 10x leverage, margined in USDC, hourly funding. Users get linear price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Adapter snapshot 2026-09-21: mark $209.61, open interest $334.69K, 24h volume $113.84K. Added 2026-09-21 in the third Ondo Perps expansion batch, taking the registry from 45 to 56 RWA markets; the adapter's 65 live rows include 9 crypto perps (BTC, ENA, ETH, HYPE, ONDO, PUMP, SOL, XRP, ZEC) that are out of scope.
